title: Analysis run metadata (Contract D, result.json)
description: Written by component 1 to <out>/result.json on success. Doc 0 names the fields it carries; the key names below are this file's contribution and are the one thing here worth confirming with component 1 (see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #2).
